summary: Verified the exported one-file patch in a clean-room copy of the staged source. The patch dry-run and apply both exited 0, and a recursive source diff after removing generated bytecode showed only the chunked-reader module changed. With all `__pycache__` and `.pyc` files removed, the focused footer checks exited 0 (valid CRLF body and trailing request preserved; bare-LF, bare-CR and NUL footers rejected; one- and two-byte feeds preserved). The full suite passed all 78 tests. Three zero-chunk/trailer edge streams produced identical events, body and trailing data before and after the clean patch, confirming the documented leniency was not changed. The host-side patch benchmark evaluator was unavailable, so the official verdict is unverified.
next_hint: Run the host-side patch benchmark evaluator on the exported patch JSONL and compare its hidden regression result with the local footer, matrix and suite evidence.
